finalRules: Do not use Playwright/headless/local Chromium automation as final real-device evidence.
Every passing target must include owner, actualDevice, osVersion, browserVersion, evidenceRefs, mediaProcessingAudit, and per-check evidence.
Every passing mediaProcessingAudit.evidenceRef must cite release:no-media-evidence:scan and a tracked redacted no-media scan artifact.
PWA and Cast targets require HTTPS app/receiver evidence.
evidenceIntake.notes: Pending real-device evidence intake. Filip/manual QA must attach the per-target evidence refs before manual-device QA can pass --require-final.

lanChecks.runtimeEnvResult: VITE_XTREAM_SERVER=https://gw.castcdn.net:443; VITE_XTREAM_PROXY_ORIGIN=https://fin-edited-contracting-newbie.trycloudflare.com; VITE_CATCHUP_GATEWAY_ORIGIN=https://fin-edited-contracting-newbie.trycloudflare.com; runtime requests observed through HTTPS proxy tunnel

localQaServer.notes: Local LAN QA server is prepared for manual device checks. The current web runtime is a production preview build and points proxy/catch-up traffic at the HTTPS Cloudflare proxy tunnel to avoid mixed-content blockers when the app is opened from HTTPS staging. This does not count as real-device evidence and does not move any target out of pending.

httpsStagingTunnel.runtimeEnvResult: output/playwright/mobile-layout-smoke/report.json records xtreamServer=https://gw.castcdn.net:443 plus HTTPS proxy origin and proxyRequestSamples through the Cloudflare proxy tunnel

runtime proxy and catch-up gateway origins use HTTPS Cloudflare tunnel

mobile TV Unazad opens the Gledanje unazad panel and remains on /player

httpsStagingTunnel.notes: Ephemeral HTTPS staging is prepared for manual PWA/real-device QA setup. Cloudflare quick tunnel URLs are not guaranteed stable and are not a substitute for final real-device, Cast registration, or production HTTPS receiver evidence.

targets.name: Desktop Chrome on Windows

checks.description: Live channel starts, renders video, and can recover from normal channel zapping.
Playable catch-up exposes controls and seek without switching to remux/transcode transport.
Series/VOD -> TV Uzivo restores the live shell and live startup mode behaves as configured.

targets.notes: Use docs/qa/qaf035-real-device-qa-guide.md evidence template. Keep pending until real Windows Chrome evidence is recorded.

targets.name: Desktop Safari on macOS

checks.description: VOD playback starts and controls remain usable under Safari media policies.
Live channel starts, renders video, and handles Safari autoplay constraints cleanly.
Broken catch-up shows provider/failure overlay and does not trigger remux/transcode.

targets.notes: Use docs/qa/qaf035-real-device-qa-guide.md evidence template. Keep pending until real macOS Safari evidence is recorded.

targets.name: Mobile Chrome on Android

checks.description: Live playback starts and touch controls/fullscreen/orientation remain usable.
Catch-up controls and seek work with touch input or show a clear unsupported overlay.
Background/foreground resume does not corrupt player state or login/session state.

targets.notes: Use docs/qa/qaf035-real-device-qa-guide.md evidence template. Keep pending until real Android Chrome evidence is recorded.

targets.name: Mobile Safari on iOS

checks.description: Live playback works with iOS native media behavior and controls remain usable.
Catch-up failure handling is clear and never solved via remux/transcode path.
Returning from detail/player/navigation paths restores the expected live shell.

targets.notes: Use docs/qa/qaf035-real-device-qa-guide.md evidence template. HTTPS is required for final PWA evidence.

targets.name: Google Cast to Chromecast

checks.description: Sender connects to Chromecast receiver and starts remote playback.
Switching local to cast and back to local preserves usable playback/navigation state.
Cast failures emit sanitized observability evidence and do not hide media-path violations.

targets.notes: Use docs/qa/google-cast-readiness-guide.md. Keep pending until public HTTPS receiver, custom Cast app id, and real Chromecast evidence are recorded.

targets.name: AirPlay to Apple TV
targets.expectedDevice: Safari/iOS sender plus Apple TV target

checks.description: Sender routes playback to Apple TV through AirPlay and playback starts.
Disconnecting AirPlay returns to local playback or a clear recoverable state.
AirPlay failures are visible, actionable, and do not trigger remux/transcode fallback.

targets.notes: Use docs/qa/qaf035-real-device-qa-guide.md evidence template. Keep pending until real AirPlay/Apple TV evidence is recorded.

targets.name: PWA install and offline recovery
targets.expectedDevice: Android Chrome and/or iOS Safari installed app

checks.description: PWA can be installed or added to home screen from a supported browser/device.
Installed app shell opens offline to a controlled state without pretending media is playable offline.
App recovers after reconnect and resumes provider-backed navigation/playback flows.

targets.notes: Use docs/qa/qaf035-real-device-qa-guide.md evidence template. Keep pending until HTTPS install/offline/reconnect evidence is recorded.

signoff.notes: Partial manual real-device QA evidence only. This artifact must stay pending until Windows Chrome, macOS Safari, Android Chrome, iOS Safari, Chromecast, AirPlay/Apple TV, and PWA install/offline checks are executed on real targets with screenshot/report/network evidence.
